# dm-csv-017

## Instruction
Follow the instructions in data_standard.md to calculate the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the dataset. After calculating the Net_Promoter_Score, save the results following the format and structure provided in the file template.

## About Dataset
The dataset consists of NPS survey responses collected from three channels: email, mobile, and web. Each survey contains customer ratings from 0 to 10 indicating likelihood to recommend. The data also includes a corrupted.csv file that may contain malformed records.
